verdict.rationale: Claude Code offers official IDE integrations (VS Code extension with inline diffs, @-mentions, plan review, conversation history; JetBrains plugin with diff viewing and selection context sharing) enabling in-editor contextual chat, plus terminal use, corroborated by GitHub repo stating 'Use it in your terminal, IDE, or tag @claude on Github.' Community feedback is mixed on quality/reliability but does not dispute the core IDE integration capability.
